hypothesis: The best validated candidate (c024, score +0.715, robust +0.211) combined criticality-weighted contrastive loss with a criticality-aware area-balance repair whose shrink coefficient was 3.0; c026 showed that raising it to 6.0 over-tightened and hurt ariane133, so this combine step modestly tightens the *criticality penalty* in the repair's move-scoring from 0.05 to 0.10 (a x2 fine-tune of the only coefficient c024 introduced), keeping the proven 3.0 area shrink and density cap intact — this should preserve critical-pair co-location slightly more strongly without the over-constraining that hurt c026.
expected_effect: WNS: neutral to small improvement (~+0–5%); TNS: small consistent improvement across all three cases (~+2–6%); overflow unchanged (~120); runtime unchanged. Robustness preserved (no new failure modes since only a scalar coefficient changes).
analysis: The hypothesis held: the x2 criticality-penalty fine-tune (0.05→0.10) with the proven 3.0 shrink improved all three cases (total +0.600, robust +0.186, all valid), avoiding c026's over-tightening. Gains are broad—bp_fe-ng45 leads on dTNS (+23.7%), ariane133 and bp show ~+20% dWNS—consistent with stronger critical-pair co-location without density over-constraint. Next: sweep the penalty 0.10–0.15 on ariane133 to confirm 0.10 is near-optimal before locking it in.
